head: working-tree
subject: RDS regex path rewrite with capture substitution
change: RouteAction.regex_rewrite (field 32) now decodes RegexMatchAndSubstitute, compiles the pattern with the bounded xDS safe-regex parser, validates RE2-style \0..\9 substitution references, and applies leftmost-first global replacement while copying owned request inputs. Greedy and lazy quantifiers keep their priority semantics. Replacement runs on an explicit backtracking stack with hard step, choice and capture-trail budgets; the selector precomputes the exact rewritten length so the existing single-allocation request-input copy and max_header_bytes check remain unchanged.

unit: src/grpc/xds/routing/regex/replace_tests.zig covers numbered groups, global replacement, lazy quantifiers, inline case folding, \0 and \\, unmatched groups, Unicode captures, unknown group references and the backtracking budget.

src/grpc/xds/rds/tests.zig 'gRPC RDS applies regex rewrites and rejects format rewrites' decodes a route with ^/service/([^/]+)(/.*)$ -> \2/instance/\1, asserts the selected output length and rewritten path, and rejects empty rewrites, unknown capture references, malformed patterns and format path_rewrite.
src/grpc/channel/shared/request_inputs_tests.zig applies the selected regex rewrite through the production owned-input copy and verifies the rewritten path, authority and header mutation layout.

request_inputs.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='shared request inputs' --summary all

full_library.note: The three failures were MQTT bridge timeout tests under concurrent host load; each passed when rerun in isolation.

notes: Route path regex rewriting is covered by native tests and 1,333 independent RE2 WASM replacement vectors. Hash-policy header regex rewriting, path_rewrite_policy format rewrites, host_rewrite_path_regex and non-router HTTP filters remain open.
